sections.title: About this page
blocks: HTML rendering of QA_Assessment_Report.md, which is the artifact under review.
The US 62039 / US 60737 change is NOT deployed. This run records the current baseline only. Nothing was saved, edited or deleted.

items: Today: GDS-type rules allow 150 routes and show an Airlines field; LCC-type rules allow 50 and show none. Code: maxRoutes = GDS ? 150 : 50.
At the limit (from code): Add blocked with "Maximum {max} routes reached."; over the limit Save is disabled.

9 suppliers are type "Both" (API). They act as LCC today (50, no Airlines); per PO-CRF-10 they count as LCC, so AC 1 should give them 150. The GDS→LCC "Supplier Change" dialog hard-codes 150 → 50 (OQ-D8).
3 of 4 Findings closed as intended/explained by the user. AC 2 still cannot be observed (not deployed).

items.body: Supplier names in the app do not match the story/intake names (Sabre, NDCsbr, AmadeusNDC, AmdNDC, AmdNDCaaaa).

fields.label: Answer
fields.value: Names on this environment were entered this way on purpose; on Production they are correct.

items.body: Origin/Destination offer an "All Airports" option, not mentioned in the Project Context.

fields.label: Answer
fields.value: "All" means any airport; stored as a special id (-1 or -11); counts as 1 route toward the limit. AC 2 behaviour for "All" routes still open.

items.body: Cancel goes back to the previous page (location.back()). From the list it returns to the list; the Dashboard was seen only when /add was opened by URL from the Dashboard.
AC 2 not observable (not deployed, server-side). The live limit probe was refused; the limit rules were read from the front-end code instead.
OQ-D6 (part): does AC 2 add the airline for "All Airports" routes? (user: not known)
OQ-D7: 9 suppliers are type "Both" (ShuraTech, FlyEgypt, FlyEgyptUAE, ShuraTechGLC, MIK, FlyAdealNDC, ShoraNDC, Spicejet, USBanglaUAE). They behave as LCC; covered as LCC per PO-CRF-10.
OQ-D8: the "Supplier Change" dialog (150 → 50, routes removed) must be removed after AC 1 (PO-CRF-16).
ASM-CRF-4: does the post-response airline filter stay after AC 2, and how is a Blacklist airline sent? Server-side — cannot be seen before deployment.
